Agent Name: WebServing_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebServing_Expert made a factual error by stating that the picture of St. Thomas Aquinas was first added on October 2, 2019. This claim was incorrect and contradicted the subsequent code execution performed by the Validation_Expert, which successfully retrieved the Wikipedia revision history and identified the first addition of the image on December 10, 2024. The error occurred because the expert provided an unverified and false date without consulting the actual edit history logs, failing the initial step of the manager's plan to "track the changes and edits."
